lead.headline: 20.75 from Lamb and Pierce decides it — and Love locks Thursday
lead.deck: Every AVIATO player is final at 89.76; ESPN gives JuiceJam 65%. Green Bay play Thursday, so Allen has to go back in before then.
lead.body: Start with the bad news, unchanged since the morning: Garrett Wilson drew three targets for 4.6 and was seen arguing on the sideline over red-zone calls (Glenn: 'overblown'), Isaiah Likely caught two for 12 in McCarthy's first Giants start, DK Metcalf managed 7.6 on six targets, and the Broncos D/ST finished on 4. JuiceJam need 20.75 from CeeDee Lamb and Dameon Pierce tonight; Barkley is trending toward playing, which keeps Pierce a backup. One thing is new this afternoon: Green Bay play Carolina on Thursday night, so Jordan Love's game — and Jalen Coker's, limited Monday with a shoulder — come first in Week 8. Put Allen back in the QB slot before that kickoff or Love locks there. Pittman's foot may cost him the season, which only firms up Metcalf's role. Tuesday picks a tight end and a kicker for the Likely and Fairbairn byes.
